• Install, service, and repair a range of residential and light commercial HVAC systems, including split systems, ducted systems, and multi-head units.

• A relevant trade qualification (Certificate III in Air Conditioning and Refrigeration or equivalent).

• Excellent problem-solving abilities and a strong attention to detail.
• Outstanding communication skills and a professional, customer-focused attitude.
• The ability to work effectively both autonomously and as part of a collaborative team.
• An unwavering commitment to workplace health and safety.

result.description:
Engineering Technologist (protection) - Full Time
$80,000-85,000 AUD annually plus superannuation
A.C.N. 656 274 501 PTY LTD T/A Spark Professional Services
Stimson St, Guildford, NSW 2161
ABN 40 656 274 501
About Us:
Spark Professional Services is a leading Australian provider of high and low-voltage electrical engineering solutions, delivering specialised services in testing, commissioning, protection systems, switching, maintenance, and engineering design. With over 15 years of industry expertise, the company supports critical infrastructure projects across data centres, mining, renewable energy, utilities, commercial and industrial facilities, and transport infrastructure sectors.
The successful candidate will contribute to the delivery of protection engineering projects including data centre switchgear systems, substations, transmission and distribution networks, and industrial power infrastructure.
Duties and Responsibilities:
1.	Analyse and interpret existing and emerging engineering technologies related to protection philosophies, single-line diagrams, and relay schematics for power system protection. 
2.	Apply technological advancements in the design, configuration, and application of protection relays and schemes. 
3.	Assist engineers in designing and developing protection schemes for electrical systems, including transformers, feeders and generators. 
4.	Configure, program, and set protection relays in accordance with coordination studies. 
5.	Perform protection coordination and grading studies to ensure selectivity and reliability of the protection system. 
6.	Troubleshoot and diagnose protection relay malfunctions, mis-operations, and scheme design issues. 
7.	Recommend modifications and improvements to protection schemes based on technical evaluations and fault analysis. 
8.	Review relay settings and protection schemes for compliance with utility, regulatory, and industry standards. 
9.	Assist in the commissioning and functional testing of protection schemes, ensuring correct relay operation and system integration. 
10.	Collaborate with testing and commissioning technologists, engineers, and technicians to integrate new protection technologies into ongoing projects. 
11.	Identify and investigate protection system failures, trips, and abnormalities, recommending corrective actions. 
12.	Perform periodic reviews and updates of protection settings to reflect system changes and load growth across client networks. 
13.	Ensure protection system designs comply with regulatory requirements, grid codes, and industry standards. 
14.	Monitor and enforce safety measures related to protection system design, settings changes, and implementation. 
15.	Prepare technical reports, protection setting sheets, coordination studies, and documentation for projects and system modifications. 
16.	Maintain accurate records of relay settings, coordination studies, protection scheme changes, and test results. 
Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience
•	Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
•	Minimum 1 year of relevant industry experience in protection systems, testing, commissioning, or electrical infrastructure projects
•	Knowledge of HV/MV protection systems, protection relay testing, and commissioning practices
•	Familiarity with protection coordination, SCADA integration, and fault diagnosis within electrical networks
•	Experience using engineering and protection software such as ETAP, DigSILENT PowerFactory, or similar systems
•	Understanding of AS/NZS standards, WHS legislation, and electrical safety procedures
•	Strong analytical, technical troubleshooting, and documentation skills
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within project teams
•	Willingness to travel to project sites as required
•	What We Offer
•	Competitive salary package and superannuation
•	Professional development and career progression opportunities
•	Exposure to major infrastructure and electrical engineering projects
•	Supportive and technically focused working environment

A.C. Goulding Services Pty Ltd delivers high-quality air conditioning and refrigeration solutions across commercial projects. We specialise in tailored systems designed to meet complex project requirements and deliver optimal performance in every environment.

•	Conduct system testing, including pressure and leak testing using gas or fluid
•	Commission new systems and perform test operations, adjustments and calibrations
•	Diagnose faults and carry out repairs and component replacements
•	Conduct routine servicing and preventative maintenance
•	Respond to breakdowns and complete urgent repairs as required
•	Maintain accurate service records, including fault identification and corrective actions taken

•	Relevant trade qualification in Refrigeration and Air Conditioning
•	Current and valid driver’s licence
•	Minimum 2 years’ relevant industry experience
•	Demonstrated experience in servicing, maintenance and breakdown diagnostics
•	Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding skills
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team

result.description:
We are looking for an experienced and strategic ICT Manager to lead the planning, development, and day-to-day management of our organisation's information and communication technology systems. This role is central to ensuring our technology infrastructure supports business objectives effectively and securely. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical knowledge, sound leadership capability, and the ability to translate complex ICT requirements into practical solutions. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to drive digital initiatives and maintain a reliable, secure, and efficient ICT environment.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to meet current and future business requirements
Formulate, implement, and continuously review ICT strategies, policies, and operational plans aligned with broader organisational goals
Direct the evaluation, procurement, and installation of ICT hardware, software, and infrastructure, ensuring value for money and fitness for purpose
Oversee the security and integrity of all ICT systems, including risk assessments, data protection compliance, and incident response planning
Set priorities and allocate resources across system development, maintenance, and daily operations to ensure continuity of service
Lead and manage the ICT team, including recruitment, performance management, professional development, and workload planning
Direct the provision of user training and technical support, ensuring staff are equipped to use systems effectively
Manage vendor and contractor relationships, including negotiating contracts, monitoring service levels, and ensuring delivery against agreed outcomes
Develop and manage ICT budgets, tracking expenditure and identifying opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising performance
Oversee the implementation of new systems and technology projects, managing timelines, risks, and stakeholder communication throughout
Ensure ICT operations comply with relevant legislation, industry standards, and internal governance frameworks
Produce and present regular reports on ICT performance, project progress, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
Proven experience in an ICT management or senior technical leadership role, typically five or more years
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement ICT strategies, policies, and operational frameworks
Strong knowledge of network infrastructure, systems administration, cybersecurity principles, and cloud-based technologies
Experience managing budgets, vendor contracts, and procurement processes within an ICT context
Solid understanding of data privacy legislation and information security standards, including ISO 27001 or equivalent
Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to mentor and develop technical teams
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with a structured approach to decision-making
Effective communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience delivering ICT projects using recognised project management methodologies such as PRINCE2 or Agile
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification in IT management, business administration, or a related field
Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CISSP, or equivalent
Experience working within regulated industries or government environments
Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) or customer relationship management (CRM) platforms
Knowledge of COBIT or other IT governance frameworks
Experience leading digital transformation or large-scale systems migration projects
Why Join Us?
Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values technology as a driver of business success
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including funded certifications and leadership programmes
Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options to support work-life balance
Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation and performance-based incentives
Contribute to meaningful projects that have a real impact on organisational outcomes and service delivery
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Full time | Term Contract (temporary up to 10 March 2028)

Eligibility: Open to Everyone

About the Role:

Join the Riverland Mallee Coorong Community Health team as a CME Administrator and play a vital role in supporting quality healthcare across the region. In this rewarding position, you'll manage client information and medical records, provide accurate reporting, and help ensure community health services run efficiently making a meaningful contribution to the health and wellbeing of local communities every day.

What We're Looking For:

Essential Criteria 

Strong administrative, communication and organisational skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Experience using and troubleshooting client management-database systems, including training others.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and the preparation of reports, data analysis and statistical reporting.

Experience in records management with strong attention to detail and sound judgement.

Ability to solve problems, adapt to change and work effectively with diverse people and stakeholders.

Desired Criteria 

Experience developing policies and procedures, with strong leadership, training and document management skills.

Knowledge of community health services, database systems, reporting tools and records management standards.

Experience in quality improvement, accreditation and working within a health-related environment.

About Us

The Riverland Mallee Coorong Local Health Network, called RMCLHN for short, supports more than 70,000 people living in country South Australia in the towns and surrounds of Renmark, Paringa, Berri, Barmera, Waikerie, Loxton, Pinnaroo, Lameroo, Karoonda, Mannum, Murray Bridge, Tailem Bend, Meningie, Tintinara and Coonalpyn. Click here for more information about working for RMCLHN.

We will provide support, both personally and professionally giving you access to a range of education and training opportunities designed to enhance your role.

Offer flexible work arrangements to better balance work, personal life, and family commitments.

Provide an inclusive workplace culture that values diversity, ensuring every employee feels a sense of belonging and safety.

Offer salary sacrifice benefits, watch a short video about what salary packaging is.

Provide Relocation Support, where applicable. More information available from SA Health Careers - Relocation support

Join RMCLHN's Corporate and Administration Professionals Team (video)

Applicant Information

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants are encouraged to apply.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Check(s)

National Police Certificate (NPC) for employment involving unsupervised contact with vulnerable groups required for this position (E.g. aged care employment or work involving vulnerable clients)

Immunisation Risk for this position is - Category B

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.
